title: Mahākoṭṭhita
html:
• Theragāthā 1.2 Verses of the Senior Monks 1.2
  • Ekakanipāta The Book of the Ones
  • Paṭhamavagga Chapter One

Mahākoṭṭhikattheragāthā Mahākoṭṭhita

“Upasanto uparato, Calm and still, mantabhāṇī anuddhato; thoughtful in counsel, not restless— Dhunāti pāpake dhamme, he shakes off bad qualities dumapattaṁva māluto”ti. as the gale shakes leaves off a tree.

Itthaṁ sudaṁ āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko thero gāthaṁ abhāsitthāti. That is how this verse was recited by the senior venerable Mahākoṭṭhita.
